title: Skips on a Pet's Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Subscription and Prescription Diet Days
content:
**Care academy training note**

**Q. Why do skips on the pet's existing Autoship Pharmacy subscription matter for a new prescription diet Autoship (an Autoship Pharmacy subscription under Tailwise Autoship for the pet's Rx Prescription Diet prescription)?**
A. Skips on the pet's existing Autoship Pharmacy subscription show that pharmacy deliveries for the pet have been arriving while stock remained, so the diet shipment, which joins those deliveries, carries fewer days.

**Q. How many days?**
A. Two or more skips the customer requested on that existing subscription in the last twelve months take 4 days off the diet days; exactly one takes 2 days off; none takes no days off.

**Q. Which period?**
A. A record counts as dated in the last N months when its date is later than the same calendar day N months before the day the value is worked out, so a record dated exactly N months earlier does not count; a record dated between six and twelve months ago is one dated in the last twelve months but not in the last six months.

| Customer-requested skips on the pet's existing Autoship Pharmacy subscription, last twelve months | Days off |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 4 |
| exactly 1 | 2 |
| none | none |

Automatic backorder skips are not customer-requested and do not count.
